title: td2d asset

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editors. Ignored by td2d.

schemaVersion.description: Document schema version. Any 1.x.y version is accepted.

id.description: Optional. When present it must equal the directory path under assets/.

type.description: Asset category. Selects type defaults such as frame size.

description.description: Free-text note. Use this instead of comments.

tags.description: Lowercase labels for finding assets, such as "wood" or "enemy". The viewer filters by them.

frame.description: Final sprite cell size in pixels.

pixelsPerUnit.description: Pixels per metre in the final sprite; the camera frustum width is frame.width / pixelsPerUnit. "auto" picks the largest whole number that fits the model in every direction with one pixel to spare, and records it in the manifest.

camera.description: Camera preset name, or an object with an optional preset and overrides.

pitch.description: Degrees above the horizon the camera looks down from. 30 gives 2:1 pixel lines at 45 degrees of yaw.

yawOffset.description: Degrees added to every direction yaw.

groundMargin.description: Pixels between the pivot (ground) line and the bottom edge of the frame. "auto" picks the smallest margin that keeps the footprint in front of the pivot inside the frame in every direction.

anyOf.description: A camera preset name plus overrides, or a complete inline camera.

lighting.description: Lighting preset name, or an object with an optional preset and overrides.

space.description: camera: lights turn with the camera so every direction shades alike. world: lights stay fixed.

azimuth.description: Degrees around the vertical axis. 0 points from the viewer.

oneOf.description: Directional light.
Uniform ambient light.
Sky and ground gradient light.

lights.description: One to eight lights: directional, ambient or hemisphere.

color.description: Colour of the shadow. Sprite alpha is binary, so the shadow is drawn solid in this colour.

anyOf.description: A lighting preset name plus overrides. A lights array replaces the preset lights.

yaw.description: Degrees, clockwise from facing the camera.

items.description: A named direction at an explicit yaw.

start.description: Yaw of the first direction in degrees. Default 0 (facing the camera).

anyOf.description: count directions evenly spaced around the model, named a<yaw> such as a0, a60, a120.

directions.description: Directions to render: a set name such as "d8", compass names, or custom yaws.

mirror.description: Directions produced by flipping another direction horizontally, as "target:source".

supersample.description: Render at this multiple of the frame size. Default 4.

lines.description: Lines the renderer draws along every step in depth and every boundary between two lined materials, on the nearer side: round the silhouette and inside it. none (the default) draws none.

width.description: Line width in final sprite pixels. Default 1.

color.description: A #rrggbb colour for every line, or shade: each part's line is a darker shade of the part's own colour, as pixel artists draw them. Default shade.

shade.description: With color shade, the line's brightness as a share of the part's colour. Default 0.4.

depth.description: The smallest step in depth that gets a line, in metres. Flat surfaces are never lined however steeply they are tilted. Default 0.015.

anyOf.description: Lines drawn by the renderer around each part.

normals.description: Also write a normal map: each sprite's view-space surface normals at sprite resolution, as <sheet>-normals.png in the same layout as the sheet, for engines that light sprites. Default false.

pixel.description: Pixel preset name, or an object with an optional preset and overrides.

downscale.description: Downscale filter from the supersampled render. Both use the share of the block that is covered for alpha. box averages the colours, which smooths shading but makes in-between colours; mode takes the most common colour, which keeps only rendered colours.

alphaThreshold.description: Pixels with alpha at or above this value become opaque; all others become transparent.

bleed.description: Give transparent pixels the nearest opaque colour so engines that filter textures do not show dark halos.

posterize.description: Quantise each colour channel to this many levels before palette mapping.

paletteScope.description: For auto palettes: one palette for the whole asset (stable), or one per clip.

dither.description: Ordered dither used while mapping to a palette. Position-based, so it does not crawl between frames.

ditherStrength.description: How far dithering may push a colour, from 0 to 1.

side.description: outside grows the silhouette by the outline; inside recolours its edge pixels.

connectivity.description: 8 (default) outlines diagonal corners too; 4 leaves them open for a softer look.

snapToPalette.description: Replace the outline colour with the nearest palette colour. Default false.

anyOf.description: One-colour outline drawn from the alpha mask.

outline.description: none, or a one-colour outline drawn from the alpha mask.

cleanup.description: What to do with stray single pixels.

orphans.description: off: keep everything. remove: delete opaque pixels with fewer than minNeighbours opaque neighbours. recolour: give single pixels whose colour matches none of their neighbours the most common neighbouring colour. true means remove.

minNeighbours.description: For remove: fewest opaque 4-neighbours a pixel needs to stay. Default 1.

passes.description: Run these passes in this order instead of the default. It must start with downscale and include alphaThreshold.

anyOf.description: A pixel preset name plus overrides.

sheet.description: Sheet preset name, or an object with an optional preset and overrides.

layout.description: grid: one row per clip and direction, one column per frame. strips: a separate sheet for each clip and direction. packed: sprites packed tightly with the maxrects algorithm.

order.description: Sequence order. clip-direction groups the sequences of a clip together; direction-clip groups by direction.

flow.description: grid and strips: each clip and direction runs along a row (left to right) or down a column.

split.description: Make a separate sheet for each clip or each direction. Sheets also split when they would exceed maxSize.

trim.description: packed: cut each sprite to its opaque pixels. The offset is recorded so pivots stay correct.

extrude.description: Pixels of edge duplication around each cell, for engines that filter textures.

powerOfTwo.description: Round sheet sizes up to powers of two.

maxSize.description: Largest sheet edge in pixels. Larger layouts split into numbered sheets.

anyOf.description: A sheet preset name plus overrides.

export.description: Export preset name, or an object with an optional preset and overrides.

items.description: Output format identifier.

formats.description: Formats to write. manifest is always written.

png.description: How sheet PNGs are written: indexed or RGBA, and compression.

indexed.description: auto writes indexed PNGs whenever a palette is set.

variant.description: hash: frames keyed by name. array: frames in a list, each with a filename.

frameNames.description: index names frames 0, 1, 2 like Aseprite's "{frame}" item filename, which Phaser's createFromAseprite needs. descriptive names them "<asset> (<clip>_<direction>) <n>.png".

directory.description: Where the sheet images will live in the Godot project. Default res://.

background.description: transparent, or a #rrggbb colour behind the sprites. Default transparent.

anyOf.description: An export preset name plus overrides.

rig.description: Rig preset name, or an object with an optional preset, scale and bone changes. A preset name in a later layer starts the rig again from that preset.

preset.description: Start from a rig preset: humanoid-basic, quadruped-basic, none, or a project preset.

scale.description: Scale every preset bone position, to fit a smaller or larger character. Default 1.

bones.description: Bones to add, or to change by name: position, parent, rotation and limits replace the preset values.

name.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

description.description: Free-text note. Use this instead of comments.

parent.description: Parent bone. null makes this the root. A preset bone keeps its parent when omitted.

anyOf.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

position.description: Rest position of the joint in metres, relative to the parent joint (or the model origin for the root).

rotation.description: Rest rotation in degrees, Euler X then Y then Z. Default [0, 0, 0].

limits.description: Allowed pose rotation per axis, in degrees from the rest pose (Euler X then Y then Z). Clips that go outside get W_CLIP_BONE_LIMIT.

items.description: One bone (joint) of a rig.

anyOf.description: Bone hierarchy for animated assets. Parts attach to bones with their "bone" field.

description.description: Free-text note. Use this instead of comments.

color.description: Either a #rrggbb colour or a palette reference. Required unless ramp is set.

index.description: Zero-based colour index within the palette.

anyOf.description: A colour taken from a named palette by index.

shading.description: toon: banded lighting. flat: unlit base colour. lambert: smooth diffuse lighting.

bands.description: Number of light bands for toon shading. Default 3. A ramp sets it to its length.

index.description: Zero-based colour index within the palette.

anyOf.description: A colour taken from a named palette by index.

items.description: Either a #rrggbb colour or a palette reference.

ramp.description: Colours from shadow to full light, each a #rrggbb or a palette reference. Toon shading paints each light level with one of them, darkest first, in place of color and bands, so shadows and highlights can change hue as in hand-painted pixel art.

hueShift.description: Degrees to turn the hue of darker toon bands, making a ramp from color: positive turns shadows towards blue-violet, negative towards yellow. The full-light band keeps color; the shadow band turns by the whole amount and the bands between by their share. Default 0.

emissive.description: Emissive colour added regardless of lighting.

outline.description: Whether render.lines may line this material. Default true. Turn it off for fine detail such as grain, stitching or strands, and for dark gaps.

opacity.description: Render opacity. The pixel stage thresholds alpha, so values below 1 produce a warning.

description.description: Free-text note. Use this instead of comments.

fps.description: Sampling rate in frames per second. Default 10.

description.description: Free-text note. Use this instead of comments.

loop.description: Looping clips omit the final frame so playback is seamless. Default true.

fps.description: Overrides the asset frame rate for this clip.

motion.description: The model moves across the frame on purpose (a dash or a jump), so the jitter check skips this clip.

keys.description: Pose keys. Use keys or generator, not both.

t.description: Key time in seconds from the start of the clip.

propertyNames.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

rotation.description: Rotation from the rest pose: [x, y, z] degrees (Euler X then Y then Z) or a quaternion [x, y, z, w].

anyOf.description: Quaternion [x, y, z, w]; normalised before use.

translation.description: Offset from the rest position in metres, in the parent bone frame.

scale.description: Scale relative to the rest pose.

target.description: Where this bone's joint should be, in model space (metres, Y up).

pole.description: Direction the middle joint (knee or elbow) bends towards. Default: +Z or -Z, whichever side the middle bone's X limits allow, so knees bend forwards and elbows backwards on the humanoid rig.

keepOrientation.description: Keep this bone's orientation in model space while the chain bends, with its own rotation applied on top, so a planted foot stays flat on the ground. Default false.

ik.description: Two-bone inverse kinematics: the two bones above this one turn so its joint lands on the target, like a planted foot or a hand on a hilt. Between two keys that both target the bone the target moves and is solved at every frame; towards a key without a target the solved rotations ease into that key's.

additionalProperties.description: Pose of one bone in a key. Missing fields hold the rest pose.

pose.description: Poses by bone name. Bones not listed hold the rest pose.

easing.description: How this key moves to the next. Default linear.

items.description: A pose at a time.

stride.description: Leg swing either side of vertical, in degrees. Default 25.

bob.description: How far the hips drop when the legs are furthest apart, in metres. Default 0.03, or with ik the drop that keeps the feet planted with straight legs at full stride.

armSwing.description: Arm swing, opposite to the legs, in degrees. Default 20.

kneeBend.description: Knee bend of the swinging leg, in degrees. Default 30. Not used with ik.

ik.description: Plant the feet: each foot stands still on the ground through its stance and lifts in an arc through its swing, and the legs are solved to reach it, so nothing slides and the knees bend as far as they need. Needs lower leg and foot bones. Default false.

lift.description: With ik: how high the swinging foot lifts, in metres. Default 0.06.

hipSway.description: Hip twist towards the forward leg, in degrees. Default 4.

lean.description: Forward lean of the spine, in degrees. Default 0.

bones.description: Bone for each role, for rigs without VRM names. Roles default to the VRM name; missing arm, spine and foot bones are skipped.

hips.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

spine.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

leftUpperLeg.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

rightUpperLeg.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

leftLowerLeg.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

rightLowerLeg.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

leftFoot.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

rightFoot.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

leftUpperArm.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

rightUpperArm.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

oneOf.description: A looping walk: legs swing with knees bending on the way forward, arms counter-swing, hips drop and twist.

amount.description: Chest tilt at the top of the breath, in degrees. Default 2.

rise.description: How far the chest lifts, in metres. Default 0.01.

bones.description: chest defaults to chest, then spine. shoulders (default the upper arms) settle as the chest rises.

chest.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

items.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

oneOf.description: A slow breath in and out over the clip.

height.description: Rise at the middle of the clip, in metres. Default 0.05.

bone.description: Bone to move. Default: the rig root, or the whole model when the asset has no rig.

oneOf.description: Rise and fall once per clip, easing in and out.

turns.description: Full turns over the clip; negative turns the other way. Default 1.

axis.description: Axis to turn about. Default y.

bone.description: Bone to move. Default: the rig root, or the whole model when the asset has no rig.

oneOf.description: Turn at a constant rate.

items.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

bones.description: A chain of bones from root to tip, such as the segments of a cape or a tail.

axis.description: Axis each bone turns about. Default x.

amount.description: Swing either side of the bias, in degrees. Default 5.

bias.description: A constant turn the swing centres on, such as a cape blown back. Default 0.

lag.description: How far each bone trails the one before it, in cycles, so the wave travels down the chain. Default 0.12.

cycles.description: Whole swings per clip, so a looping clip joins up. Default 1.

growth.description: Each bone turns this many times as far as the one before it; above 1 the tip moves most. Default 1.

oneOf.description: A wave travelling down a chain of bones, for capes, banners, tails and plumes.

generator.description: Procedural clip. td2d turns it into keys; `td2d model inspect <id> --clip <name> --keys` shows them.

layers.description: Generators layered over the clip's keys or generator, such as a sway on a cape over a walk. At every frame their rotations turn the pose further and their translations add to it.

maxColors.description: Most opaque colours allowed in any sprite.

minAlphaCoverage.description: Smallest opaque fraction of each frame.

maxAlphaCoverage.description: Largest opaque fraction of each frame.

maxJitter.description: Largest centroid move between consecutive frames, in pixels.

maxBoundsDrift.description: Largest bounding-box deviation within a clip, in pixels.

maxOrphans.description: Most isolated single pixels allowed in any sprite. Without it, isolated pixels are a warning.

items.description: Clip name in lowercase snake_case.

acceptance.description: Asset-specific checks enforced by validate and generate.

description: A td2d asset definition, stored as assets/<id>/asset.json.

id.description: Part id, unique within the asset.

description.description: Free-text note. Use this instead of comments.

position.description: Where the pivot goes, in metres in the parent frame. Default [0, 0, 0].

rotation.description: Euler rotation in degrees about the pivot, applied X then Y then Z. Default [0, 0, 0].

scale.description: Uniform or per-axis scale about the pivot. Negative values mirror. Default 1.

pivot.description: Point in the part's own frame that rotation and scale act around and that lands on position. Default [0, 0, 0], the part centre.

visible.description: Hidden parts are skipped. Default true.

bone.description: Rig bone this part follows. Children of groups and components inherit it. A copy made by mirroring across x swaps left and right in the name.

skin.description: How the part follows the rig. Default rigid, which needs bone. Inherited like bone.

skinBones.description: For nearest-bone and two-bone-blend: only these bones may move the part. Default every bone.

items.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

count.description: Number of copies, including the original.

offset.description: Translation added for each copy, in the parent frame. Default [0, 0, 0].

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees added for each copy, about the parent origin. Default [0, 0, 0].

repeat.description: Array the part: copy i is moved by i x offset and turned by i x rotation.

mirror.description: Add a mirrored copy across the parent plane through the origin, for each axis listed.

material.description: Material name from the asset (or project, or component) materials.

color.description: Colour for this part only, overriding the material colour but keeping its shading.

index.description: Zero-based colour index within the palette.

anyOf.description: A colour taken from a named palette by index.

size.description: Width, height and depth in metres.

oneOf.description: Box centred on its own origin.

rotation.description: Euler rotation in degrees about the pivot, applied X then Y then Z. Default [0, 0, 0].

scale.description: Uniform or per-axis scale about the pivot. Negative values mirror. Default 1.

pivot.description: Point in the part's own frame that rotation and scale act around and that lands on position. Default [0, 0, 0], the part centre.

visible.description: Hidden parts are skipped. Default true.

bone.description: Rig bone this part follows. Children of groups and components inherit it. A copy made by mirroring across x swaps left and right in the name.

skin.description: How the part follows the rig. Default rigid, which needs bone. Inherited like bone.

skinBones.description: For nearest-bone and two-bone-blend: only these bones may move the part. Default every bone.

items.description: Bone name. Humanoid rigs use VRM 1.0 names.

count.description: Number of copies, including the original.

offset.description: Translation added for each copy, in the parent frame. Default [0, 0, 0].

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees added for each copy, about the parent origin. Default [0, 0, 0].

repeat.description: Array the part: copy i is moved by i x offset and turned by i x rotation.

mirror.description: Add a mirrored copy across the parent plane through the origin, for each axis listed.

material.description: Material name from the asset (or project, or component) materials.

color.description: Colour for this part only, overriding the material colour but keeping its shading.

index.description: Zero-based colour index within the palette.

anyOf.description: A colour taken from a named palette by index.

radius.description: Distance from the centre to the middle of the tube.

oneOf.description: Ring lying flat in the XZ plane, centred on its own origin.

id.description: Part id, unique within the asset.
